L6_gearbox_iter.setup:
with part('Housing'):
    box(120,80,60,center=(0,0,30),name='Housing'); hollow(4,open='top')
    for x in (-30,30): hole(at=(x,-40,30),d=12.5); hole(at=(x,40,30),d=12.5)
with part('Lid'):
    box(120,80,5,center=(0,0,62.5),name='Lid')
    for x in (-52,52):
        for y in (-32,32): hole(at=(x,y,65),d=6)
with part('ShaftA'): cylinder(100,d=12,at=(-30,-50,30),axis='Y',name='ShaftA')
with part('ShaftB'): cylinder(100,d=12,at=(30,-50,30),axis='Y',name='ShaftB')
with part('Gear'):
    cylinder(10,d=50,at=(-30,-5,30),axis='Y',name='Gear'); cylinder(10,d=12,at=(-30,-5,30),axis='Y',op='cut',into='Gear')

steps.prompt: Add a second gear named Gear2 on ShaftB: a plain disc 40 mm in diameter and 10 mm thick, at the same position along its shaft as Gear is on ShaftA, with a 12 mm bore. Keep it a separate body.

Add a mounting foot at each short end of the housing, as part of the Housing body: a plate 4 mm thick, flush with the bottom of the housing, running the full 80 mm depth and sticking out 20 mm from the end wall. Each foot gets two 8 mm holes, centred across the foot's width, 25 mm either side of the housing's centre line.
Add six 8 mm lightening holes through Gear (the gear on ShaftA), evenly spaced on a 32 mm diameter circle around its axis, one of them straight above the shaft.
Make the lid 3 mm thicker, growing upwards (its underside stays on the housing). Its four corner holes still go right through, and add a 20 mm filler hole through the centre of the lid.
Cut a keyway along the full length of the pulley's bore: 6 mm wide, centred on the +X side of the bore, with its flat end 3 mm beyond the bore wall (at x = 13).
Add a 5 mm set-screw hole, drilled from the outside of the hub along -Y on the +Y side, 7 mm above the bottom face, going into the bore but not out the other side.
Make the six holes in the web 10 mm in diameter instead of 8 mm, in the same positions.
Add a copy of the finished pulley as a separate body named Pulley2, stacked directly on top of the first one (its bottom face on the first one's top face).
Lengthen the plate by 60 mm at its x = 100 end, so it is 160 mm long. Every existing feature stays where it is, and the front chamfer runs the full new length.

Add a second boss set identical to the existing one (40 mm boss 6 mm tall, 22 mm bore through, four 5 mm through holes on a 31 mm circle at 45, 135, 225 and 315 degrees), centred at x = 120, same y as the first.

The 8 mm back hole and the 4 mm chamfer hole that were nearest the old x = 100 end should now sit the same distances from the new end (12 mm and 25 mm): move them. Then add a stiffening rib on the top face along the back edge: 4 mm thick, 20 mm tall, flush with the back face, running from x = 20 to x = 140.
Round the two vertical corner edges at the back of the plate (at x = 0 and x = 160, y = 80) with a 10 mm radius.
